messages:
alisha: Massive thanks to @jorge — not only did he volunteer to escort our stuck elevator users to the meeting room, he also watered the plant wall and restocked the pump soap in the kitchen. Hero energy today. :sparkles::seedling:
zoe: Jorge is a national treasure. I came back to a note on the plants: 'Watered & cheered on' and my ficus is thriving already. :relieved::herb:
jorge: Happy to help! Ran the elevator override with facilities, then swung by the green wall. Left a tiny care note and a reminder to rotate the watering rota. No need for applause but cookies accepted. :handshake::cookie:
tom: Officially nominating Jorge for "Green-thumb & Good Samaritan" in this week's kudos roundup. Adding a one-liner to the weekly digest. :memo::trophy:
rebecca: +1 from Eng — also big thanks for saving folks from a 10-min hallway standdown. Seriously appreciate the quick thinking. :clap:
facilities-bot: FYI: Elevator incident #EL-2026 logged. Facilities dispatched at 09:12; incident resolved 09:28. Plant-care supplies order recommended: `PUMP-SOAP-REFILL`, `MIST-20ML`, `PEAT-POTS`. Request via facilities-requests channel.
alisha: I'll add Jorge to the kudos thread and drop a small plant-care guide in the handbook — simple dos/don'ts for the wall. Also placing an analog sign-up sheet near the kitchen for watering duties.
zoe: I'm putting an emoji reaction poll: :seedling: for "I'll sign up" and :eyes: for "remind me later". React away.
rebecca: :seedling:
tom: :seedling:
jorge: :eyes: (I could use a helper though!)
alisha: Thanks team. Little acts like this ripple big — appreciate everyone stepping up.
